## Change

Describe the behavior and link the approved issue.

## Verification

- [ ] Added or updated a focused test at the changed observable boundary.
- [ ] Ran `make verify` or documented why a required gate could not run.
- [ ] Updated affected product documentation.

## Security

- [ ] Preserved Organization isolation, route permissions, and file-backed secrets.
- [ ] Identified dependency, Relay-protocol, and migration compatibility impacts.
